item.title: Tallahassee gallery celebrates Black History Month with art, film, and community events
item.description: The 621 Gallery in Railroad Square is hosting "Where We Stand," a month-long Black History Month series. Organizers say it highlights African American culture through modern expression.

item.title: Exotic animal veterinary services expand in Tallahassee with new veterinary hospital
item.description: In a unique partnership, PetSmart is working with the private hospital to allow even the most unconventional pets through its doors.

item.title: Highland Games bring Scottish tradition and strength competition to Tallahassee
item.description: The games trace their roots back centuries, when Scottish clans gathered not to fight, but to compete, celebrate, and come together.
